name: CausalAdmission.leastJerk_continuous
statement: theorem leastJerk_continuous (J S : ℝ) : Continuous (leastJerk J S)

name: CausalAdmission.leastJerk_before
statement:
theorem leastJerk_before {J S t : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S)
    (ht : t ≤ rampTime J S) : leastJerk J S t = J - S * t

name: CausalAdmission.leastJerk_after
statement:
theorem leastJerk_after {J S t : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S)
    (ht : rampTime J S ≤ t) : leastJerk J S t = -J

name: CausalAdmission.jerk_lower
CausalAdmission.leastAccel_before
statement:
theorem leastAccel_before {a0 J S t : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S)
    (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht : t ≤ rampTime J S) :
    leastAccel a0 J S t = a0 + J * t - S * t ^ 2 / 2

name: CausalAdmission.leastAccel_after
statement:
theorem leastAccel_after {a0 J S t : ℝ} (hJ : 0 < J) (hS : 0 < S)
    (ht : rampTime J S ≤ t) :
    leastAccel a0 J S t = a0 - J * (t - rampTime J S)

name: CausalAdmission.acceleration_lower
CausalAdmission.nonpositive_acceleration_deadline
statement:
theorem nonpositive_acceleration_deadline {a0 J S T : ℝ} {a j s : ℝ → ℝ}
    (ha0 : 0 < a0) (hJ : 0 < J) (hS : 0 < S) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (h : IsAdmissible a0 J S T a j s) (hz : a T ≤ 0) :
    deadline a0 J S ≤ T

name: CausalAdmission.leastAccel_derivative
statement:
theorem leastAccel_derivative (a0 J S t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (leastAccel a0 J S) (leastJerk J S t) t

name: CausalAdmission.leastJerk_right_derivative
statement:
theorem leastJerk_right_derivative {J S : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (leastJerk J S) (leastSnap J S t) (Ici t) t

name: CausalAdmission.least_isAdmissible
statement:
theorem least_isAdmissible (a0 T : ℝ) {J S : ℝ} (hJ : 0 < J) (hS : 0 < S) :
    IsAdmissible a0 J S T (leastAccel a0 J S) (leastJerk J S) (leastSnap J S)

name: CausalAdmission.least_reaches_zero
statement:
theorem least_reaches_zero {a0 J S : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 < a0) (hJ : 0 < J) (hS : 0 < S) :
    leastAccel a0 J S (deadline a0 J S) = 0

name: CausalAdmission.original_deadline_impossible
statement:
theorem original_deadline_impossible {a j s : ℝ → ℝ}
    (h : IsAdmissible (5/2) 10 400 (1/4) a j s) : a (1/4) ≠ 0

name: CausalAdmission.exact_acceleration_residual
statement:
theorem exact_acceleration_residual {a j s : ℝ → ℝ}
    (h : IsAdmissible (5/2) 10 400 (1/4) a j s) : (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ a (1/4)

name: CausalAdmission.leastVelocity_after
statement:
theorem leastVelocity_after {v0 a0 J S t : ℝ} (hJ : 0 < J) (hS : 0 < S)
    (ht : rampTime J S ≤ t) :
    leastVelocity v0 a0 J S t = v0 + a0*t - J*t^2/2 +
      (2*J^2/S)*t - 4*J^3/(3*S^2)

name: CausalAdmission.velocity_lower
statement:
theorem velocity_lower {v0 a0 J S T : ℝ} {v a j s : ℝ → ℝ}
    (h : IsAdmissible a0 J S T a j s)
    (hv : ContinuousOn v (Icc 0 T)) (hv0 : v 0 = v0)
    (hvd : ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 T, HasDerivAt v (a t) t)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) : leastVelocity v0 a0 J S t ≤ v t

name: CausalAdmission.exact_velocity_residual
statement:
theorem exact_velocity_residual {v a j s : ℝ → ℝ}
    (h : IsAdmissible (5/2) 10 400 (3/10) a j s)
    (hv : ContinuousOn v (Icc 0 (3/10))) (hv0 : v 0 = 5/16)
    (hvd : ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 (3/10), HasDerivAt v (a t) t) :
    (31/240 : ℝ) ≤ v (3/10) - 5/8
